layout.footer: You are receiving this email because you use Pitchorium.

technicalTest.subject: Pitchorium test email
technicalTest.heading: Test email
technicalTest.body: This email was sent on {{sentAt}} to check the delivery pipeline.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your email address
emailVerification.preview: Confirm your email address to complete your Pitchorium account.
emailVerification.heading: Hello {{name}},
emailVerification.body: Confirm your email address to publish a project, contribute and write to members outside your network.
emailVerification.ignore: If you did not create a Pitchorium account, you can ignore this email.

magicLink.subject: Your Pitchorium sign-in link
magicLink.preview: Sign in to Pitchorium in one click.
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Pitchorium
magicLink.body: Click the button below to sign in. This link works only once.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not request this link, you can ignore this email: your account remains protected.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preview: Choose a new password for your Pitchorium account.
passwordReset.heading: Hello {{name}},
passwordReset.body: A password reset was requested for your account. The link below works only once. All your sessions will be signed out after the change.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.preview: Your Pitchorium account was signed in to.
newSignIn.heading: Hello {{name}},
newSignIn.body: Your account was signed in to on {{signedInAt}} (UTC) from the following device: {{device}}.
newSignIn.notYou: If this was not you, sign out your sessions and change your password right away.
newSignIn.reason: You receive this email for every sign-in from a new device.

signInMethodChanged.subject: Your sign-in methods changed
signInMethodChanged.preview: A sign-in method of your Pitchorium account was changed.
signInMethodChanged.heading: Hello {{name}},

changes.linked: {{method}} was added to your sign-in methods on {{changedAt}} (UTC).
changes.unlinked: {{method}} was removed from your sign-in methods on {{changedAt}} (UTC).
changes.password_reset: Your password was reset on {{changedAt}} (UTC). All your sessions were signed out.

signInMethodChanged.notYou: If you did not make this change, secure your account right away.
signInMethodChanged.reason: You receive this email for every change of your sign-in methods.
